rules.winner: QQQ prior close > 165d SMA -> TQQQ; 4% stop below session open, armed when QQQ first minute < 20d SMA * 1.01; stop fills next minute and stays out to the next session open; else BIL.
rules.gaparm: winner + arm the stop on any session with QQQ gap <= -1.5%.
rules.suppress: winner but once QQQ <= -3% from prior close, disable the stop for the day.
rules.prior_down_arm: winner + arm the stop after a prior QQQ session <= -2%.
rules.standalone_event: QQQ gap <= -1.5% on a bull-regime session; buy TQQQ at the next session open if the regime is still on; hold 1 session; 4% stop below the session open; exit on regime off.
